citations.assessment: The two adjacent teachers give opinions about suffering. The retrieved version supplies Yosef after beRabbi, while Heilprin leaves it unexpanded here.

holds.reason: The comparative witness has R. Natan son of R. Yosef. Heilprin’s bare beRabbi may depend on another printed reading. Preserve both forms pending collation.
